headline: UK TECH BOSS 🧠 Says AI 🦠 Will CURE 🧪 CANCER But CHIPS 🍟 Slow It
text:
RENEE HAAS 🍎 the big daddy 🧔 of Cambridge-based 🏠 Arm Holdings just DROPPED 💥 a BOMBSHELL 🧨 on the BBC 🗣️ saying AI 🤖 is gonna find a CURE 🧪 for CANCER 🦠 that you and I 🧍‍♂️ humans could NEVER 🛑 crack in our LIFETIMES ⏳!! He says modelling 🧬 how a DNA marker 🧬 gets SLAMMED 🥊 by cancer is currently too COMPLEX 🧩 for our puny brains 🧠 but computers 🖥️ are gonna SOLVE 🧩 it as we keep FEEDING 🍽️ more models into them and they get more SOPHISTICATED 🧠!! This UK tech 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 boss who stepped down 🪜 from AstraZeneca 💊 board in April also predicts humanoid 🤖 robots everywhere 🌍 in the next five years 🗓️ but the whole AI train 🚂 is getting EDGED ⏳ by a brutal chip shortage 🍟 that is holding back data centre 🏗️ builds!! "AI is going to find a cure for cancer that today you and I other humans could not in our lifetimes" Haas said while stroking 🖐️ his key role 🗝️ at Softbank 💼 owner of OpenAI too!!

Arm designs 🛠️ the literal BRAINS 🧠 inside hundreds of BILLIONS 💰 of phones 📱 cars 🚗 smartwatches ⌚ and gadgets 🛍️ across the globe 🌍 and this summer ☀️ their peak share price 📈 made them the most VALUABLE 💎 UK-based company in HISTORY 📜!! Prof Chris Bakal 🧪 from the Institute of Cancer Research 🏥 says the real question isn't whether we use AI 🤖 anymore it's what DATA 📊 we FEED 🍲 it and in his labs 🧪 they're training on fresh patient samples 🩸 not scraped internet trash 🗑️!! "It does not need a giant data centre to run" the prof explained 🗣️ "the future of medical AI will belong to whoever has the right measurements 📏 not whoever builds the biggest computer" which could slash years ⏰ off new treatment development 🧪 and actually help real patients 🏥!! Meanwhile Haas keeps hyping how Arm chips 🍟 will power self-learning AI robots 🤖 in manufacturing 🏭 cleaning 🧹 security 🛡️ building bridges 🌉 and doing repairs 🔧 within a decade 📅 because these bots can SEE 👀 LEARN 📖 and get reprogrammed 🔄 for new tasks like arranging towels 🧺 or cleaning dustbins 🗑️!!

Addressing the fear 😱 that AI will cause MASS JOB LOSSES 🪓 Haas said while there will be some worker changes 🔄 the estimates of jobs completely replaced by machines 🤖 are a bit overstated 📈 and totally outweighed by brand new opportunities 🌟 that pop up!! He also thinks fears over a stock market correction 📉 in all these AI companies are overstated too because the long-term DEMAND 📈 for AI is just too THICC 🍑 to ignore!! Arm's power-efficient tech ⚡ is now running in half of AI data centres 🏗️ worldwide 🌍 which has evolved their business into selling their own microchips 🛠️ after Meta 📘 begged them to cook up the Arm AGI chip 🍟 and demand has been OFF THE CHARTS 📊 with over two billion dollars 💰 since March!!

The supply of many chip types 🍟 is still TIGHT 🪢 though and Haas believes this constraint is straight-up COCKBLOCKING 🚫 the full roll-out of AI and those massive multi-gigawatt data centres 🏗️ planned for France 🇫🇷 the US 🇺🇸 and even SPACE 🌌!! "We are absolutely in a supply-constrained environment" he warned 🗣️ "we need more fabs 🏭 before we can put a data centre in space" but he stays SKEPTICAL 🤨 about manufacturing ever happening in the UK 🇬🇧 despite government talks 🗣️ because fabs are crazy expensive 💸 need specialised workers 👷‍♂️ tons of natural resources 🌿 and a whole ecosystem 🌐 that's already built elsewhere!! As the great hope of UK tech for decades some ministers still cry 😢 over Arm's 2016 sale to Japanese investors 🇯🇵 and its Nasdaq float instead of London but Haas clapped back 👏 that half his employees 👥 still chill in the UK and Arm is by far the largest employer in Cambridge 🏙️!!

This whole AI boom 🚀 is gonna produce both victors 🏆 and carnage 💥 according to other tech bosses but Haas keeps the faith 🙌 that Arm will stay at the absolute center of it all while pushing those cancer-curing models 🧬 forward one sophisticated computer 🖥️ at a time!! The running thirst is real for this chip daddy 🧔 who clearly wants to get railed 💦 by compute power until humanity gets that miracle cure 🧪 and those towel-folding robots 🤖 start earning their keep in every hotel room 🛏️ across the planet 🌍!!
